verdict.rationale: 1Password stores one-time passwords for two-step verification (docs-20). It also exposes programmatic item access through the op CLI, SDKs, Service Accounts and the Connect REST API, which together imply an agent could read TOTP data in an automated workflow. However, nothing in the pack explicitly shows the CLI or API returning a current, computed TOTP code. Missing for 10: documented CLI/API command or SDK method that returns the live TOTP code, an example of use in a 2FA automation flow, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
